posts.cooked:
With the exception of Freedom 5, they were all really close matches. Many teams were able to take advantage of Mordengrad discarding Carrion Fields and Cohorts.

Some highlights:

Nightmist in Mist Form allowing for consequence free bird destruction.

Lifeline coming back from 1 HP to 27 HP as part of a huge upset victory for team Space.

Luminary completely shutting down Carrion Fields with Regression Turret and getting a damage boost from Mobile Alert Platform.

Medico just barely keeping Void Guard alive for basically the entire game.

Visionary putting the Mask and 7 birds under Matriarch's deck and using deck control to get her to play Darken the sky 2 additional times afterward.
